verdict.rationale: Deel documents two credential types, API tokens and OAuth2 [deel-docs-27]. Its OAuth2 lets an app access "specific data" with explicit user consent [deel-docs-28], and the MCP server uses an OAuth2 flow for agent clients [deel-docs-17], which implies some scoping of agent access. However, nothing documents granular scopes, per-token permission restriction, or least-privilege token issuance for agents. missing for 10: an explicit list of scopes or permissions, the ability to restrict API tokens to specific resources or actions, agent-specific credential issuance and revocation, and independent corroboration.
